title: TC-DB-02-01/02 invalid pool_size validation tests permanently stubbed despite being pure unit-testable
summary: tests/unit/db_test.zig contains TC-DB-02-01 (pool_size below lower bound) and TC-DB-02-02 (pool_size above upper bound) but both unconditionally return error.SkipZigTest. These tests exercise Pool.init returning error.InvalidPoolSize, which is a pure configuration validation that fires before any database connection is attempted. They require no live PostgreSQL instance and can be run as ordinary unit tests. The stub comment claims DB access is needed, but no network call is made when pool_size is out of range.

root_cause.details: The tests were incorrectly classified as requiring DB access and stubbed accordingly. Pool.init validates pool_size against compile-time constants before calling pg.Pool.init. Passing an invalid pool_size can be tested entirely in-process with no external dependencies.

prevention: Before stubbing a test as needing DB access, verify whether the tested code path actually reaches the DB connection layer or whether a precondition check returns early.
Tests that validate error.InvalidPoolSize, error.InvalidConfig, or any validation error should default to being unit-testable unless a DB call is explicitly in the code path.
